name: WeSee
impact: Ahoi attack exploiting malicious #VC interrupts breaks SEV-SNP
mitigation: Linux kernel hotfix for the #VC handler; upgrade the kernel and use hardware features
boundary_statement: WeSee (CVE-2024-25745) injects malicious #VC interrupts to break AMD SEV-SNP.

AMD-SEV-SNP.evidence: Page: 'All SEV-SNP processors are vulnerable to WeSee' (Ahoi #VC attack, CVE-2024-25742).
